scripts.script: local c=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character  local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera  local hum=c.Humanoid  local animation=Instance.new("Animation") animation.AnimationId="rbxassetid://180436334" local track=hum:LoadAnimation(animation) track:Play(1,5,1)  local hrp=c.HumanoidRootPart  local cfr=hrp.CFrame while c.Parent==workspace do     local delta=task.wait()     cfr=cfr+hum.MoveDirection*delta*20     if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude~=0 then         cfr=cfr:Lerp(CFrame.new(cfr.Position,cfr.Position+hum.MoveDirection),math.clamp(delta*10,0,1))                  hrp.CFrame=cfr*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-75),0,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)         track:AdjustSpeed(1)     else         hrp.CFrame=cfr*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-50),0,0)*CFrame.new(0,0,-2.5)         track:AdjustSpeed(0.01)     end     hrp.Velocity=Vector3.zero     hrp.RotVelocity=Vector3.zero end

function clerp(c1,c2,al)
    local com1 = {c1.X,c1.Y,c1.Z,c1:toEulerAnglesXYZ()}
    local com2 = {c2.X,c2.Y,c2.Z,c2:toEulerAnglesXYZ()}
    for i,v in pairs(com1) do
        com1[i] = v+(com2[i]-v)*al
    end
    return CFrame.new(com1[1],com1[2],com1[3]) * CFrame.Angles(select(4,unpack(com1)))
end

local function HSV(H,S,V)
H = H % 360
local C = V * S
local H2 = H/60
local X = C * (1 - math.abs((H2 %2) -1))
local color = Color3.new(0,0,0)
if H2 <= 0 then
color = Color3.new(C,0,0)
elseif 0 <= H2 and H2 <= 1 then
color = Color3.new(C,X,0)
elseif 1 <= H2 and H2 <= 2 then
color = Color3.new(X,C,0)
elseif 2 <= H2 and H2 <= 3 then
color = Color3.new(0,C,X)
elseif 3 <= H2 and H2 <= 4 then
color = Color3.new(0,X,C)
elseif 4 <= H2 and H2 <= 5 then
color = Color3.new(X,0,C)
elseif 5 <= H2 and H2 <= 6 then
color = Color3.new(C,0,X)
end
local m = V - C
return Color3.new(color.r + m, color.g + m, color.b + m)
end
